metric: M11 parallel-agent collision recall >= 90%, false alarms <= 10%

definition.window: a run's window = [first complete step, last complete step]; two runs are parallel when a.first <= b.last + N and b.first <= a.last + N, N = 15 minutes
definition.touched: a run edits a function = an edit step whose edited text lies in that function (innermost function/method; a whole-file write edits every function in the file); a run reads a function = a read step whose line range overlaps it (a whole-file read reads every function in it). Only complete steps count: a tool call without a result yet, or a truncated last JSONL line, is ignored
definition.collision: two parallel runs, not ancestor/descendant of each other (a parent and its own subagent = delegation), where one run edits a function f and the other edited or read a function g with f == g, or a directed call chain f -> .. -> g or g -> .. -> f of at most 2 calls edges
definition.notCollision: siblings under a common caller, a common callee, 3+ hops, same file but unrelated functions, non-overlapping windows, unrelated files
definition.graph: T1 indexer call graph (calls edges) of the root checkout plus every worktree a compared run worked in, workspace packages @mole/* mapped to their src (cross-package calls), node = repo-relative path#Qualified.name
definition.note: also reported (not scored by M11): a run edits a function a .mole/notes note is anchored to

scoring: candidate pairs = every unordered pair of the listed runs (real: real.runs, planted: planted runs); flagged = pairs collisions() reports. recall = flagged pairs labelled collision / pairs labelled collision; false alarms = flagged pairs not labelled collision (labelled not, or unlabelled) / flagged pairs. Real and planted are pooled for the target and also printed apart.
